notes:
Changes:
- Playback is far smoother, because panes that are off screen no longer keep working in the background
- Long track lists use much less memory, and pressing next no longer freezes the app
- Per-song lyric timing offset, so lyrics that run early or late can be nudged into place
- Lyrics tools moved into chips beside the source badge, with a romaji toggle
- Lyrics translation now offers 44 target languages instead of 12
- The seek bar shows how much of a streamed track has buffered, and marks the wait before it starts
Fixes:
- Right-to-left lyrics were reversed once a line went active
- Resetting all keyboard shortcuts did nothing
- Cached stream URLs survived a playback mode change and played the wrong source
- Cover art was requested far larger than it is shown
- Backend log records never reached the debug ring, so bug reports arrived without diagnostics
